effect_description_eng:
When one of your [Paildramon] or [Dinobeemon] would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend all of your Digimon with ＜Jamming＞
